description: Pattern-based prevention rules for Neon Survivors (RSON) — Godot 4.6 GDScript regression detection

rules.name: Boss attack stage condition without test coverage
rules.message: Boss attack logic gated on stage check — verify all branches are reachable with test coverage
rules.suggestion: Add unit test verifying each stage value triggers the correct boss attack branch

rules.name: Time.get_ticks_msec() used for game logic timing
rules.message: Time.get_ticks_msec() advances during pause — use pause-aware time source for game logic
rules.suggestion: Use Engine.get_process_frames() or a custom GameManager clock that pauses with SceneTree.paused

rules.name: Ad/IAP function returns without logging on failure
rules.message: Ad/IAP function returns false/null without logging — monetization failures will be invisible
rules.suggestion: Add push_warning('AdMob: interstitial failed because...') before every return false/null in ad functions

rules.name: IAP node instantiated but not added to scene tree
rules.message: Node instantiated with .new() but never add_child()ed — signals and _ready() will never fire
rules.suggestion: Call add_child(node) in _ready() or use @onready + scene instantiation

rules.name: Plain-text JSON save without encryption
rules.message: Save file written as plain-text JSON — game state is unprotected and trivially editable
rules.suggestion: Use FileAccess with encryption key, or Marshalls.variant_to_base64() with a salted key

rules.name: get_nodes_in_group() called in _process or _physics_process
rules.message: get_nodes_in_group() called per-frame — traverses entire scene tree every frame, causes O(N) overhead
rules.suggestion: Cache the group result in _ready() and update via group_added/group_removed signals, or use a manager singleton

rules.name: Node allocation per-shot (PointLight2D, SceneTreeTimer)
rules.message: Node or timer allocated per-shot — causes GC pressure and potential visual flicker; use object pooling
rules.suggestion: Pre-allocate a pool of projectile/light nodes in _ready() and reuse via visible=true/false

rules.name: Time.get_unix_time_from_system() in game logic
rules.message: Time.get_unix_time_from_system() returns wall-clock time — non-deterministic and pause-unaware
rules.suggestion: Use Engine.get_process_frames(), a custom game clock, or deterministic date-based seed
